I added `discount_cents: int = 0` to `Invoice` in `src/billing/invoices.py`. It sits after `tax_cents` and follows the same integer-cents convention. I didn't run anything or add tests.

It's a new field with a default, so existing `Invoice(...)` calls still work. It's also placed before `ledger_ref`, so anything that passes `ledger_ref` positionally would now get the wrong value.

`finalize()` still posts `subtotal_cents + tax_cents`, so the discount isn't applied to the amount sent to the ledger yet. If you want it subtracted, the change is one line in `finalize()`. That function posts to the external ledger and isn't idempotent, so I left it alone. Do you want the discount applied there?
